metadata.name: Paperclip
metadata.description: Paperclip is an open-source self-hosted board for managing AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Gemini CLI. Assign work to agents, run them, and track cost and output from a single dashboard.
metadata.tagline: Self-hosted board for managing AI coding agents
metadata.author: BigBearTechWorld

environment_variables.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
environment_variables.description: Session signing secret as 64-character hex. Paperclip refuses to start without it. This default is published in a public repository, so replace it before real use. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

environment_variables.name: PAPERCLIP_TOOL_ACTION_SIGNING_SECRET
environment_variables.description: Signs agent tool-action approvals as 64-character hex. The server boots without it but every agent approval fails. This default is published in a public repository, so replace it before real use. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

environment_variables.name: PAPERCLIP_PUBLIC_URL
environment_variables.description: External address Paperclip is reached on. Sign-in callbacks fail unless this matches the address you actually browse to, so change localhost to the server LAN IP or domain, for example http://192.168.1.50:3101.

environment_variables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: Anthropic API key for Claude Code agents. Optional: Paperclip runs without it, but Claude agents cannot.

environment_variables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: OpenAI API key for Codex agents. Optional: Paperclip runs without it, but Codex agents cannot.

environment_variables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: Google Gemini API key for Gemini CLI agents. Optional: Paperclip runs without it, but Gemini agents cannot.

environment_variables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environment_variables.description: GitHub token used by agents to read and write repositories. Optional: Paperclip runs without it, but repository actions fail.

volumes.description: Paperclip data and embedded PostgreSQL storage

before_install.en_us: This app ships with placeholder secrets so it starts without configuration. They are published in a public repository. Rotate BETTER_AUTH_SECRET and PAPERCLIP_TOOL_ACTION_SIGNING_SECRET with 'openssl rand -hex 32' before using it for anything real. See the app README.

after_install.en_us: Change PAPERCLIP_PUBLIC_URL to the exact address and port you actually browse to, then restart the container. Use the port your platform serves Paperclip on, which is not always 3101: on Umbrel it is 10201, and on Runtipi it is whatever APP_PORT is set to. For example http://192.168.1.50:3101 on CasaOS or Portainer, http://192.168.1.50:10201 on Umbrel. Sign-in callbacks fail while this points at the wrong host or port.
